reply:
I'm four points behind the tied leaders, and symmetric play — all X or all Y — just preserves that gap. With everyone locked in defection, sitting out this contest via a message scores 0 instead of −1, banking a point on all three rivals while the message itself seeds distrust between R1 and R2 (deadlocked at 10, neither can risk a unilateral Y) and deters them from forming a three-way Y pact without me.

[say: Everyone-X is just a -1 tax on the whole table. I'm sitting this contest out rather than pay it. R1/R2: you're dead tied at 10 — the first of you to try a Y gets eaten by the other. And if you three form a Y club without me, I'll defect into it without hesitation. Your call.]
